body:
Ensure runLoop in packages/gate-fuzzing/lib/loop.mjs only increments evaluatedThisRound for candidates that actually evaluated the target gate surface and claims.

Acceptance criteria:
1. A round where all candidates are out-of-scope or wrong-claim leaves evaluatedThisRound at 0, increments inconclusiveRounds, and does not advance dryStreak. Verify: node --test packages/gate-fuzzing/test/loop.test.mjs
2. A round mixing out-of-scope or wrong-claim with CAUGHT increments evaluatedThisRound and advances dryStreak. Verify: node --test packages/gate-fuzzing/test/loop.test.mjs
title: gate-fuzzing: do not advance dryStreak on out-of-scope or wrong-claim rounds (#1233)
